{{Quote|Disaster. We have abandoned Ord Radama. Venemal is dead and so is the legion of troops under my command. My resupplies never arrived. No doubt Minister Shareis felt Lord Adraas, or some other dilettante, should be well armed for another needless inspection tour. Through his incompetence, the Empire is losing its hold on the systems we have only just secured. Imbeciles, all of them.|An entry from Darth Malgus's war journal|<ref name="BookOfSith" />}}
The '''Battle of Ord Radama''', later known as the '''Harrower Disaster''', was a major engagement of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the belligerent powers of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] had previously been a holding of an old [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], but had fallen under the rule of the Republic since the [[Battle of Rakata Prime|conclusion]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Although it was situated within the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] in the [[Seat of The Empire]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had resisted [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] conquest in the Great Galactic War until [[3660 BBY]], during the [[Rim Campaign]] led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Malgus]] and [[Darth Venemal]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the two led a [[Fleet/Legends|detachment]] of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial naval armada]] to the world and began an eighty-six-[[Standard day/Legends|day]]–long campaign to secure it for the Empire.

The battle began with an assault on a [[Mountain/Legends|mountaintop]] [[Ord Radama Republic stronghold|Republic stronghold]] while Imperial dreadnaughts set up a defensive perimeter in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above the planet. Malgus and Venemal led the successful incursion [[Ground warfare/Legends|on foot]] and established a beachhead on the planet to plan for an advance on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Livien Magnus]], which was heavily fortified against attack by [[Republic soldier]]s and [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]], as well as an all-enveloping [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]]. Fourteen days after their touchdown on the planet, the Imperials launched their [[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege|siege]] of the capital, with Malgus planning on winning though attrition. A [[Standard week/Legends|week]] into the onslaught, he and Venemal were joined by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Adraas]], who traveled to the planet with [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] under the orders of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]]. Although Republic [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] quickly destroyed Adraas's [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the distraction allowed Malgus and Venemal to lead [[Troop/Legends|troops]] into the city and destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]].

After using [[Bombing run|air strikes]] to quash native resistance, the Sith Lords occupied the capital as a headquarters while they waited to be resupplied. The situation quickly turned to crisis for the Imperials: as they ran low on war matériel, the Republic retaliated by sending a sizable fleet of [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] and [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] to retake the [[Ord Radama system/Legends|system]] and uproot the entrenched Imperial ground forces. Although Malgus attempted to take command of the [[Space warfare/Legends|situation]] in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], he quickly lost most of his fleet, and the battle became untenable. After one of the Empire's damaged [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnaughts]] fell to the surface of Ord Radama and obliterated Livien Magnus and all of the Imperial forces stationed within—including [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Venemal—Lord Malgus was forced to retreat from the planet aboard the dreadnaught ''[[Lindworm]]''.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I will not allow the Jedi to eliminate us by assaulting a secure fortification in overwhelming numbers. The Sith will not repeat the mistakes of Bothawui.|Darth Malgus's final journal entry before the invasion of Ord Radama|<ref name="BookOfSith" />}}
[[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had established as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] for the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], the world was allied with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces of [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] and [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Empire]], but fell back into Republic control following the [[Battle of Rakata Prime|conclusion]] of the conflict.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> However, in [[3681 BBY]], the revived [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] spilled out of its hidden enclave in the nearby [[Stygian Caldera]] and began a campaign of conquest across the Outer Rim. In the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of this [[Great Galactic War]], the Empire focused on securing outlying Republic worlds and reconquering planets that had previously been holdings of older Sith regimes. These efforts were widely successful until the [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|Battle of Bothawui]] in [[3671 BBY]], at which point the Empire was forced to reevaluate its efforts and postpone its plans to advance on the Republic's [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

In response, the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] put into motion several new initiatives. The first was the manipulation of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] clans to engage in the [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]], meant to [[Blockade/Legends|prevent]] the movement of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] to the Core Worlds and the transportation of military wares to embattled Republic [[Army/Legends|armies]] in the Outer Rim. The blockade was highly successful and held for a [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="JoMGD" /> allowing for the Empire to launch another highly successful offensive by [[3660 BBY]]:<ref name="Arda" /> the [[Rim Campaign]]. Overseen by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Angral]], the Rim Campaign was focused on securing holdings in the Outer Rim, such as the worlds of the Esstran [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that had not yet fallen to the Empire. Two ascendant [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], [[Darth Malgus]] and [[Darth Venemal]], were placed in command of one of Angral's [[Legion/Legends|legions]] of [[Imperial soldier]]s as well as a small [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] with orders to reconquer Ord Radama—one of the campaign's primary targets.<ref name="BookOfSith" />

==The battle==
===Early invasion and the conquest of Livien Magnus===
{{Quote|Standing atop a siege tank, my mighty call echoed for kilometers: 'YOU ARE THE SERVANTS OF THE EMPEROR AND OF THE EMPIRE! YOU ARE THE ENGINE OF CONFLICT. YOU ARE TRANSFORMING THE GALAXY!' The soldiers raised their weapons and their voices in agreement. Our progress has been swift. We will soon take the capital city of Livien Magnus.|Darth Malgus, in the aftermath of the initial invasion|<ref name="BookOfSith" />}}
Despite a minor tactical setback for Malgus's and Venemal's forces during a previous engagement in the war, the two Sith moved forward with the offensive. The Sith Empire invaded Ord Radama on the one hundred and twenty-ninth day of the Rim Campaign, carried there by two [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnaughts]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Malgus's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the dreadnaught ''[[Lindworm]]''. While their [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] secured [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] positions, Malgus and Venemal led the advance forces of their legion [[Ground warfare/Legends|to the surface]] aboard [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]] and [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class interceptors]]. Their first target was a [[Ord Radama Republic stronghold|Republic stronghold]] positioned atop a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] and defended by [[Mine/Legends|mines]], [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]], and [[Merr-Sonn Bellower]] [[Turret/Legends|turret]] emplacements. The [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] touched down amid heavy fire, and managed to safely unload the first waves of [[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|Imperial commandos]] and the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lords]] leading them. Malgus and Venemal led the charge, using their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] to defend the single-file lines of [[Infantry/Legends|infantrymen]] behind them from [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. The Merr-Sonn turrets on the cliff face above them targeted the invading forces' dropships instead of the advancing soldiers; while the [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] successfully destroyed two of the landing craft—the Empire's only losses of the day—the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on the ground were able to make their way to a rock formation at the cliff's base for cover. While their soldiers remained protected, Malgus ordered Venemal to [[Force jump/Legends|jump]] up to the gun emplacements and take out the operators. The Sith was successful, and his [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] shortly joined him on the ledge via [[Ascension gun/Legends|ascension cables]].<ref name="BookOfSith" />

[[File:Ord_Radama_mountain_assault.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Republic stronghold assault plan, depicting mines, turret placements, and Imperial movements]]
Darth Malgus, meanwhile, remained at the foot of the mountain and led his remaining soldiers in a march up a narrow incline path to the stronghold. However, before he made progress up the mountain, Malgus sensed that the path was blocked by mines that Republic forces had placed. To protect his men, the Sith Lord used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|lift]] a boulder from the mountainside and roll it along the path twenty paces before them. The tactic worked to detonate the mines prematurely, allowing the Imperials to proceed uninhibited. A hidden group of Republic ambushers were scattered by the explosions, and Imperial troopers promptly [[Death/Legends|killed]] them with their [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]]. At the crest of the mountain, Venemal's commandos moved through the stronghold, eliminating the Republic defenders and leaving no survivors. Malgus's men soon joined the team, and together, they secured the area. The Empire's [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] signaled the success to the ''Lindworm'', which began landing the remainder of the Imperial legion in the fields at the base of the mountain. For the four days following their landfall, the invaders established a bivouac as they prepared for a march on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Livien Magnus]]. When their temporary staging area was finally established, Malgus addressed his forces from atop a [[Imperial crawler tank|crawler tank]] while they prepared their equipment for further battle, reminding them of their purpose and reenergizing them for the fight ahead.<ref name="BookOfSith" />

Ten days after Malgus's speech, the Empire began its siege of Livien Magnus. The city was heavily fortified by [[Republic soldier]]s and artillery, and an all-enveloping [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] protected the city from attack, with the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] located within the city itself. The Sith led the attack on the city, intending to assault the capital and starve its people until the Republic was forced to surrender. This war of attrition continued for a [[Standard week/Legends|week]], but was brought to a premature end by the arrival of Lord [[Adraas]], a [[Politics/Legends|political]] rival of Malgus's. The Dark Council, having grown impatient with the progress of the Ord Radama conquest, sent Adraas on a battlefield inspection tour with a compliment of five [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] of [[Sith war droid Mark I|Mk. I Sith war droids]] and five platoons of [[Sith war droid Mark II|Mk. II Sith war droids]] under orders to end the siege of Livien Magnus and bring the battle to a conclusion. Malgus and Venemal both scoffed at his presence and doubted the effectiveness of the [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]], but silently concurred during a strategy meeting that the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] could serve as a useful distraction.<ref name="BookOfSith" />

Thus, the two Darths allowed Lord Adraas to go ahead with his haphazard plan to charge the city's [[Livien Magnus's southern gate|south gate]]. As they predicted, the entrenched Republic soldiers guarding the entrance to Livien Magnus obliterated the droids with blaster fire. In spite of the significant losses, Malgus and Venemal managed to salvage a victory by staging a secondary and simultaneous attack on the city's [[Livien Magnus's western wall|western wall]]. While the Republic defenders were focused on the incoming droids, Venemal led his commandos over the wall and blew a hole in it from the inside. This allowed Malgus and his legion to enter Livien Magnus, and within an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] the shield generator had been disabled. As a final measure to secure victory, Malgus ordered [[Bombing run|air strikes]] to destroy insurgent enclaves within the city.<ref name="BookOfSith" />

===Republic victorious===
{{Quote|Nothing could be gained by remaining in the star system. I ordered the dazed navigator to maneuver the ''Lindworm'' behind the ion minefield and to make the jump into the heart of Sith Space.|From Darth Malgus's war journal|<ref name="BookOfSith" />}}
[[File:Adraas_Malgus_Venemal.jpg|thumb|right|280px|{{C|From left to right}} Lord Adraas, Darth Malgus, and Darth Venemal during a strategy session]]
In the aftermath of the siege, the Imperials occupied Livien Magnus as a base of operations while they claimed the rest of the planet. Although his droids had been a failure on the battlefield, Lord Adraas took credit for the victory in his report to Darth Angral before departing the world and leaving Malgus and Venemal to manage the remainder of the campaign. The two Sith held the city and its central [[Livien Magnus palace|palace]] for nearly thirty days after the battle, defending it from insurgent forces with [[cacophanizer shell]]s and the force of their legion. Although their initial victory had been relatively swift, the occupation began to drag on, resulting in a mounting death toll for the Imperials and a crisis of dwindling supplies. Resupplying procedure was typically managed through the [[Ministry of Logistics]], but because Malgus had a poor relationship with [[Minister of Logistics]] [[Shullis Khamarr]], he instead submitted requests for equipment and supplies to [[Shareis]], the [[Minister of War (Sith Empire)|head]] of the [[Ministry of War (Sith Empire)|Ministry of War]].<ref name="BookOfSith" />

To the detriment of the Imperial occupation force, resupplies and reinforcements never arrived at Ord Radama. Sixty-five days after the end of the siege of Livien Magnus, a Republic fleet consisting of four [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruisers]] and ten [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]] arrived in the [[Ord Radama system/Legends|Ord Radama system]] and [[Space warfare/Legends|assaulted]] the Empire's fleet in orbit. Vastly outgunned and taken by surprise, the Imperials were given little [[Time/Legends|time]] to react. The ''Lindworm'' was pummeled with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire before it or either of the ''Harrower''-class dreadnaughts were even able to launch their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complements, allowing the Republic [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] to gain an early advantage. Although at least one [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Mark VI ''Supremacy''-class starfighter]] was able to enter the fray, it and the Imperial capital ships were overwhelmed by the Republic's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]], and [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class tactical strikefighters]]. One of the ''Harrower''-class dreadnaughts was heavily damaged in the fighting, forcing its crew to evacuate via [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]; the other [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruiser]] was detrimentally compromised, its [[Hull/Legends|hull]] having been ripped open by [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]].<ref name="BookOfSith" />

Having witnessed the beginning of the battle from the balcony of Livien Magnus's [[palace]], Darth Malgus summoned his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Karm]], to ferry him up to the ''Lindworm'' so he could take control of the engagement in orbit. By the time he reached the ''Lindworm''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] however, the situation had become untenable. One of his ships had already been abandoned and the ''Harrower''-class dreadnaught that had been battered by torpedoes began to fall into Ord Radama's [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]]. Unable to maintain orbit, the massive vessel fell to the surface of the planet and impacted in the middle of Livien Magnus, obliterating the city and instantly killing Darth Venemal, the Imperial legion that had been stationed within, and approximately one hundred thousand citizens. The loss enraged Malgus, who let loose a powerful [[Force scream/Legends|Force scream]] that injured many of the ''Lindworm''{{'s}} crewmen and destroyed a full wave of ''Aurek''-class strikefighters. Recognizing that the battle was lost, Malgus ordered the ''Lindworm'' to retreat back to [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith space]].<ref name="BookOfSith" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The Republic pursued us. The Mandalorian Blockade has now fully crumbled. The enemy fleet has penetrated Imperial space.|Darth Malgus's journal entry in the aftermath of Ord Radama|<ref name="BookOfSith" />}}
The defeat at Ord Radama was costly for the Empire. From beginning to end, the fight for the planet lasted approximately eighty-six days and claimed over one hundred thousand lives from the Republic, Empire, and Ord Radama's native people. The end of the battle also marked a turning point in both the Rim Campaign and the entirety of the war, as it coincided with the collapse of the Mandalorian's blockade on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. This development allowed for the free flow of Republic forces to the Outer Rim Territories, where [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] rallied their forces to strike back against the Empire. As such, the ''Lindworm'' was pursued from Ord Radama all the way into the [[Stygian Caldera]] and the [[Seat of The Empire]], where the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]] initiated a [[Battle of Korriban (3660 BBY)|feint]] against the Sith's holy mausoleum world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] before striking against [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], the original capital of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. On Ord Radama, the natives struggled to survive after the destruction of Livien Magnus. The capital was soon relocated to the city of [[New Raido]], which gained protection from Jedi defenders who disguised themselves as commoners. This deception fooled [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], which issued reports indicating that the Republic had invested little effort in securing Ord Radama against future offensives.<ref name="BookOfSith" />

Although Darth Malgus had seen success in beating back the Jedi advances into Sith [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the loss of Ord Radama cost him much political clout with the Dark Council and Darth Angral. In spite of this and rumors that he was responsible for the military defeat and the loss of Darth Venemal, he was later charged with leading the [[Reconquest of Ord Radama]]. Malgus recorded the events of both the reconquest and the original Battle of Ord Radama in his personal [[Journal of Darth Malgus|war journal]] throughout the Rim Campaign.<ref name="BookOfSith" /> After successfully conquering the planet, the Empire rebuilt Livien Magnus and expanded it to almost four times its original size. A towering statue of Darth Malgus was also constructed in the center of the city, though it was not maintained for the last five centuries of the Republic's existence. The crash of the ''Harrower''-class dreadnaught, an event that later became known as the Harrower Disaster, left the ground around the crashsite contaminated with health hazards, an issue that persisted almost four thousand years later, around the time of the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Arda" /> Around that time, the Dark Lord of the Sith [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] discovered the volume and provided it to his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], as a teaching device. Sidious and Vader both heavily annotated Malgus's account of the Battle of Ord Radama before Sidious added the piece to his religious compendium, the ''[[Book of Sith]]'', which later fell into the hands of Jedi Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] of the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="BookOfSith" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In the description of the ill-fated Battle of Ord Radama there's some name dropping of Harrower battle cruisers, Hammerhead-class cruisers, Aurek fighters, and Thranta-class corvettes. These are all in-game starships that were mentioned in the background info I received from LucasArts.|[[Daniel Wallace]]|<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_15.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 2)|date=2012-03-15}}</ref>}}
The Battle of Ord Radama was introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' with the release of ''[[Star Wars: Book of Sith]]'', an [[in-universe]] reference [[List of books|book]] penned by [[Daniel Wallace]]. ''Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side'' is presented as a series of first-person historical texts from Sith Lords and other [[darksider]]s; the section detailing the Battle of Ord Ramada is written by Darth Malgus as part of his war journal kept during the Rim Campaign of the Great Galactic War. Included in the description of the battle are notes added by Darth Sidious, Darth Vader, and Luke Skywalker, all of whom offer their insights and opinions on Malgus's words. All visual renderings of the battle within the book are also depicted as being provided by Malgus himself; ''Star Wars'' artist [[Jeffery Carlisle]] drew the images to appear as if they had been sketched "in the field." ''Book of Sith'' was released on [[February 10]], [[2012]].<ref name="BookOfSith" />

The capital city of Livien Magnus was a creation of Wallace's specifically for the project and, according to the author's endnotes for ''Book of Sith'', was a reference to the [[Livien League]] of the [[Pre-Republic era]]. Other creations that have thus far only been seen in the context of the battle are the Merr-Sonn Bellower and Darth Venemal. Other elements of the battle, like the ''Harrower''-class battle cruiser and the ''Thranta''-class corvette, were provided by [[LucasArts]] as background information from the then–recently released [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Darth Malgus and the Great Galactic War were both created by LucasArts and [[BioWare]] for the game, which was released in [[2011]]. Wallace intended for the Malgus section to be dated to [[3655 BBY]], though it was never specified in the text itself,<ref name="Endnotes" /> and the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] adventure ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'' later placed the battle in 3660 BBY.<ref name="Arda" />
